title: Future Directions
note: Generated by tools/positions.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification, kind, signed_off_by and note fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. The detector over collects on purpose: mark anything that is teaching rather than clinical direction as NOT_CLINICAL rather than deleting it.

positions.as_written: Expect the next decade's change to come from validation rather than from invention.
Treat material property estimation in vivo as the gap that would change modelling most.
Ask of any new method what reference it was validated against, since that question survives every technology.
Read a new method's arrival as the start of a validation question rather than the end of one.
Expect to wait longer for the validation of an existing method than for the arrival of a new one.
Review packs are generated per chapter from those registers, so a reviewer's decisions have a route back in.
Treat every figure on this site as unverified unless its register entry says otherwise, which today none does.
Ask of any source of knee numbers what its verification state is, and notice how rarely that question can be answered.
Use the registers rather than the prose when the question is which claims need checking.
State that a finite visible list of unchecked figures is a weaker claim than a checked one and a stronger one than silence.

Weigh the patient's age and physiology, comorbidities, knee demand, psychological state and their own ideas, concerns and expectations before passing any figure from here into a conversation, because an unverified number spoken aloud to a patient becomes a fact to them.
